elemente.text: Read the title and guess the topic.
Think of words you already know about the topic.
Look at pictures or key words before the audio starts.
Listen for names, numbers and places.
Focus on stressed words and repeated ideas.
Ignore one unknown word if the main idea is still clear.
Write down short notes instead of full sentences.
Check whether your first prediction was correct.
Summarise the main message in one or two sentences.
Compare your notes with a partner.
Mark the parts you still do not understand.
Listen a second time for missing details.
